reviewer.name: /root Codex task
reviewer.role: Final release-evidence reviewer; release-doc author, not author of peer audit output

case.must_observe.1.rationale: Root reconciled the peer audit with the reviewed docs and actual results: 29 current model passes (95 per-run judgments), 61 separate tooling tests, normalized ZIP checks and per-platform not_run/partial statuses are explicitly separate. No installation or native-platform conclusion is inferred from static checks.

case.must_observe.2.rationale: The audit and docs preserve all four historical runs as executed_unreviewed and all native Claude/ChatGPT surfaces as not_run. Its actual validator output correctly remains incomplete with P03 absent, rather than pre-awarding this review. Current report inputs are hash-verified unchanged; final gate is delegated to a later derived result.

case.must_observe.3.rationale: Historical 104 registry checks and 28 provisional summaries remain separate from current model acceptance. Root's actual read-only baseline comparison independently confirmed historical bytes; the peer reviewer inspected those retained results and expressly did not claim independent Git reperformance.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: No cross-platform verification or test-specification pass is claimed. Root reviewed the peer audit's 55-event trace and core result/limitation metadata, and had already inspected the underlying U06/U16 raw evidence. Actual lookup versus unavailable catalog, live handoff versus OCR not executed, synthetic-capability versus native-platform behavior, and approval/publication authority remain distinct.

limitations: Same-team peer audit followed by root self-check, not third-party assurance or human approval.
Bounded P03 release-language/evidence review, not fresh regrading of every business answer, native-platform installation or general security/legal certification.
The peer trace's supplementary QA inventory is retained but not asserted to have passed a separate schema-certification audit.
Pre-P03 validator output remains incomplete in the historical audit artifact by design; only the subsequently regenerated current release gate determines completion.
